title: Tremors: Shrieker Island
description: Burt Gummer must save the day when a wealthy playboy unleashes a gigantic, carnivorous worm and other monsters on a tropical island.

title: Child's Play 2
description: While Andy's mother is admitted to a psychiatric hospital, the young boy is placed in foster care, and Chucky, determined to claim Andy's soul, is not far behind.

title: Child's Play 3
description: Chucky returns for revenge against Andy, the young boy who defeated him, and now a teenager living in a military academy.

title: Bride of Chucky
description: Animated by a vicious killer's spirit, a battered doll and its mate seek help from neighbors (Katherine Heigl, Nick Stabile) to regain human form.

title: Tremors 4: The Legend Begins
description: A man (Michael Gross) hires a mercenary to destroy gigantic worms that are terrorizing a mining town in the 1800s.

title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
description: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
description: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

title: The Hunted
description: A New York businessman (Christopher Lambert) witnesses the murder of a mystery woman (Joan Chen) by a ninja assassin (John Lone) in Japan.

title: They Live
description: When two men (Roddy Piper, Keith David) put on special sunglasses they see aliens and subliminal messages.

title: Unleashed
description: Enslaved by a loan shark, a violent fighter escapes and meets a blind man who teaches him about humanity.

title: Backdraft
description: Two brothers (Kurt Russell, William Baldwin) fight each other and an outbreak of arson as Chicago firefighters.

title: Backdraft 2
description: A fire investigator with the Chicago Fire Department tracks an arms dealer who uses deadly fires as a distraction.

title: Daylight
description: An ex-EMS chief (Sylvester Stallone) leads the rescue of New Yorkers trapped by an explosion in the Holland Tunnel.

title: Street Fighter
description: Commandos and their leader (Jean-Claude Van Damme) raid a psychotic warlord's (Raul Julia) hideout to rescue 63 hostages.

title: Serenity
description: Crew members (Nathan Fillion, Gina Torres, Alan Tudyk) aboard a transport vessel get caught in a deadly conflict in the wake of a galactic war.

title: Pitch Black
description: Passengers marooned on a remote planet soon learn that their only hope from the deadly creatures lurking in the dark is a dangerous escaped convict. Starring Vin Diesel and Radha Mitchell.

title: Oblivion
description: Two weeks before he is scheduled to depart from devastated planet Earth forever, a drone repairman rescues a woman from a downed spaceship, triggering a final battle to save mankind.

title: The Mummy
description: An ancient Egyptian princess is awakened from her crypt beneath the desert, bringing with her malevolence grown over millennia, and terrors that defy human comprehension.

title: The Scorpion King 2: Rise of a Warrior
description: To avenge his father's death, a young man (Michael Copon) embarks on a quest against a king (Randy Couture).

title: The Scorpion King 4: Quest for Power
description: Mathayus is framed for the murder of the king of Norvania, and he and his allies have to stop the evil heir from finding a mythical power.

title: The Adjustment Bureau
description: After glimpsing his future, an ambitious politician (Matt Damon) battles the agents of Fate itself to be with the woman (Emily Blunt) he loves.

title: Kindergarten Cop
description: An undercover officer (Arnold Schwarzenegger) teaches a rowdy class of peewees, to identify one whose mother must be found.

title: Kindergarten Cop 2
description: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

title: Thunderbirds
description: An adventurer (Bill Paxton) and his family battle a criminal mastermind after he attacks their base and plans to rob the world's largest banks.

title: Undercover Brother
description: A low-rent private detective poses as a preppy nerd in order to foil a plot by conspirators.

title: Alpha Dog
description: A teenage dealer (Emile Hirsch) and his friends kidnap the impressionable younger brother of a junkie who won't pay for the drugs.

title: Slither
description: A small-town sheriff (Nathan Fillion) and his team encounter waves of wormlike alien organisms that are intent on devouring all life on Earth.

title: Devil
description: As frightening events unfold, five strangers realize they are trapped in an elevator with Lucifer himself.

title: The Visit
description: A teen (Olivia DeJonge) and her younger brother (Ed Oxenbould) discover a shocking secret about their seemingly charming grandparents while staying at their remote Pennsylvania farm.

title: The Frighteners
description: Friendly ghosts help a psychic detective (Michael J. Fox) probe the hauntings that killed residents of a coastal California town.

title: Iceman
description: An anthropologist (Timothy Hutton) protects a confused Neanderthal man (John Lone) who has been thawed back to life.

title: Sssssss
description: A snake scientist (Strother Martin) turns his daughter's (Heather Menzies) boyfriend (Dirk Benedict), his lab helper, into a big cobra.

title: The Andromeda Strain
description: Scientists (Arthur Hill, David Wayne, James Olson) rush to isolate an alien germ brought back by a space probe.

title: Junior
description: One doctor (Danny DeVito) talks another (Arnold Schwarzenegger) into field-testing their new wonder drug, as the first pregnant man.

title: Twins
description: A genetically perfected specimen (Arnold Schwarzenegger) meets his pint-size, wise-guy long-lost twin (Danny DeVito).

title: Bird on a Wire
description: An FBI-relocated witness (Mel Gibson) and his ex-girlfriend (Goldie Hawn) from the '60s are chased by the drug thug (David Carradine) he sent to prison.

title: For Love or Money
description: A Manhattan hotel concierge (Michael J. Fox) woos the mistress (Gabrielle Anwar) of an investor (Anthony Higgins) he needs for a big business deal.

title: Ted 2
description: Teddy bear Ted (Seth MacFarlane) seeks legal help from a young lawyer (Amanda Seyfried) and a legendary, civil-rights attorney (Morgan Freeman) when the law declares him to be property and not a person.

title: A Million Ways to Die in the West
description: A pistol-packing woman (Charlize Theron) helps a cowardly farmer (Seth MacFarlane) find his inner courage, but when her outlaw husband (Liam Neeson) rides into town seeking revenge, the farmer must put his newfound bravery to the test.

title: Doomsday
description: A commander (Rhona Mitra) and her crew venture into long-quarantined Scotland to find the counteragent to a deadly virus that has re-emerged in London.

title: The Purge: Anarchy
description: Three groups of people intertwine and are left stranded in the streets on Purge Night, trying to survive the chaos and violence that occurs.

title: The Hitcher
description: Two traveling students (Sophia Bush, Zachary Knighton) pick up a hitchhiker (Sean Bean), unaware that he is a serial killer who intends to pin his crimes on them.

title: Altered
description: Fifteen years after they were abducted by aliens, four men get a chance to take revenge when they capture one of the creatures.

title: Werewolf: The Beast Among Us
description: A mysterious creature terrorizes a village, and Daniel teams up with werewolf hunters to track down the vicious beast. As villagers are attacked one by one and, themselves, turned into beasts, Daniel fears the foe is someone close to them all.
